name: com.midtrans.sdk.uikit.views.shopeepay.status.ShopeePayStatusActivity
description: After a user starts ShopeePay wallet payments in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen shows the payment result and the QR payment instructions, expiry information, and current payment state.
disableEffect: Disabling it can hide the ShopeePay wallet payments payment result or the instructions needed to complete it.
